name: Value proposition block
definition: Section that states one core benefit in a sentence, then backs it with three concrete supporting points.
bestUse: Right after the hero, to say why this product rather than the alternatives.

demo.how: One sentence makes the claim and three short points prove it, each with a concrete number or fact rather than an adjective. Play shows the claim, then the supporting points one group at a time. Keep it to one benefit; a list of everything belongs in a feature grid. Figures are illustrative.
